name: GDAL
description: A translator library for raster and vector geospatial data formats.
summary: LLMs may only be used as improved autocompletion or for mechanical refactoring; humans must be the primary authors. Vibe-coded contributions and agent submissions are banned, and any LLM use in code, tickets or commit messages must be labelled.

evidence.quote: LLMs may only be used as an improved auto-completion mechanism, or for repeated tasks (mechanical refactoring) that could potentially be completed with a deterministic algorithm.
Submission of vibe-coded contributions is banned.
Human-coordinated or uncoordinated (OpenClaw, etc) use of agents for submission of contributions to the GDAL repository is banned.
Any LLM usage must be indicated by ticket label, comment, or commit message indication and account for what was written by whom/what.
All contributions including code, ticket comments, and commit messages should be fully understood by the author(s) submitting them to the project.
